title: The Vine, The Branches, and the Haters
paragraphs: "I am the Real Vine, and my Father is the Farmer. He cuts off every branch of mine that doesn't bear grapes. And every branch that does bear grapes, he prunes back so it will bear even more. You are already pruned by the message I have spoken.
"Live in me. Make your home in me, just as I do in you. Just as a branch can't bear grapes by itself but only by being joined to the vine, you can't bear fruit unless you're joined with me.

"I am the Vine, you are the branches. When you're joined with me and I with you—the relationship intimate and organic—the harvest is sure to be abundant. Separated, you can't produce a thing. Anyone who separates from me is deadwood, gathered up and thrown on the bonfire. But if you make yourselves at home with me and my words are at home in you, you can be sure that whatever you ask will be heard and acted on. This is how my Father shows who he is—when you produce grapes, when you mature as my disciples.

"I've loved you the way my Father has loved me. Make yourselves at home in my love. If you keep my commands, you'll stay intimately at home in my love. That's what I've done—kept my Father's commands and made myself at home in his love.

"I've told you these things for a purpose: so my joy can be your joy, and your joy fully mature. This is my command: love one another the way I loved you. This is the very best way to love. Put your life on the line for your friends. You are my friends when you do what I command you. I'm no longer calling you servants, because servants don't understand what their master is thinking and planning. No—I've named you friends, because I've let you in on everything I've heard from the Father.
"You didn't choose me, remember—I chose you, and put you in the world to bear fruit, fruit that won't spoil. As fruit-bearers, whatever you ask the Father in connection with me, he gives you.
"But remember the root command: love one another.

"If you find the godless world hating you, remember it started by hating me. If you lived on the world's terms, the world would love you as one of its own. But since I picked you to live on God's terms and not the world's, the world is going to hate you.

"When that happens, remember this: servants don't get better treatment than their masters. If they beat on me, they'll certainly beat on you. If they did what I told them, they'll do what you tell them.

"They're going to do all these things to you because of how they treated me—because they don't know the One who sent me. If I hadn't come and told them all this in plain language, it wouldn't be so bad. As it is, they have no excuse. Hate me, hate my Father—it's all the same. If I hadn't done what I've done among them—works no one has ever done—they wouldn't be to blame. But they saw the God-signs and hated anyway, both me and my Father. Interesting—they've confirmed the truth of their own Scriptures, where it's written, 'They hated me for no good reason.'

"When the Friend I plan to send you from the Father comes—the Spirit of Truth coming from the Father—he will confirm everything about me. You, too, from your side must give your confirming evidence, since you've been in this with me from the start."
